cases.designNote: Paper frame 28DS-0 still shows compact sidebar rows. This render deliberately allocates independent 44px coarse targets for the accessibility rail, so the frame needs a design refresh before the specimen and the frame agree.

excluded.reason: GitHub sign-in is out of scope for #127; the product's default sign-in is the github-disabled artboard
email verification is not a product capability in #127
the artboard is the anonymous card with its 'Create your account' navigation button rendered as pending; that button is a link to /register, not an action the product ever holds pending
under the core derivation the artboard is identical to organizations/default (no submit control to hold pending); the product's pending state is an unresolved membership query with no list to show
the web app keeps no local drafts, so there is no unsynced work to warn about before signing out
a core installation has no password-recovery entry (no outbound email), so nothing routes to the recovery notice

anti-enumeration: the server answers RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND for expired, revoked and foreign invitations alike, so the product renders the invite/revoked copy for every unavailable invitation and cannot claim expiry
